Class SetProcessor

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.substrate.hazelcast.atom.SetProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.hazelcast.map.EntryProcessor<String, AtomEntry, Boolean>, Serializable
public class SetProcessor extends Object implements com.hazelcast.map.EntryProcessor<String, AtomEntry, Boolean>, Serializable
Writes a new value and TTL to an existing atom as a single partition-local operation.

This exists because IMap.replace(key, value) discards the entry's per-entry TTL, leaving the atom with no expiration until a follow-up setTtl repairs it. An interruption in that window produces an atom that never expires and is never swept.
